author: @anditherobot

evidence.api_compatibility: This PR adds new API endpoints (GET /v1/docs, GET /v1/docs/{page}) and a new MCP tool (lemonade_docs). No existing API contracts change. However, the unversioned /docs subtree now returns a JSON 404 instead of falling through to the SPA web-app. Previously /docs/example could have been silently served by the SPA; now it will always return 404. This is a behavioral change for anyone relying on that fallback, but it is a deliberate fix for a UI leak (documented in inline review by @jeremyfowers) rather than an unintended break.
evidence.documentation: API spec updated: docs/api/lemonade.md documents both new endpoints with parameters, example requests/responses, and on-disk file paths per platform. docs/api/mcp.md documents the new lemonade_docs tool. Inline comments in server.cpp explain the /docs route precedence and the quad-prefix design. The reviewer flagged Windows doc-path backslash formatting and stale code after BUILD_DOCS_SITE was removed; both were addressed in follow-up commits. The BUILD_DOBSITE cmake option (later dropped) was noted as needing developer-guide documentation — since it was removed in the final commit, that documentation concern is moot.
evidence.manual_release_testing: CI runs the server-endpoint and C++ unit tests, which verify the HTTP endpoints exhaustively, but nothing demonstrates a human exercising the endpoints or the MCP tool by hand before merge. The MCP tool lemonade_docs — in particular — has no dedicated integration test beyond the HTTP-layer coverage; the tool itself is wired into the MCP request dispatcher but not exercised end-to-end. This is a user-facing surface (new endpoints + new MCP tool) that warrants manual verification before release.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after the first and latest approval at 2026-09-10T17:30:38Z. The 13 commits were all authored or landed before approval. Clean history.
evidence.review: PR #3347 was approved by @jeremyfowers (admin maintainer, subject area: new endpoints). Review included substantive inline comments on Windows path backslash escaping (later fixed in commit b7af60a), the /v1/docs vs /docs naming concern, a stale-code comment after BUILD_DOCS_SITE was removed, and a note that BUILD_DOCS_SITE needs developer-guide documentation. No post-approval commits were added after the sole approval at 2026-09-10T17:30:38Z. The reviewer has explicit expertise for "new endpoints" per docs/dev/contribute.md.
evidence.security: The path confinement logic in api_docs.cpp uses weakly_canonical + relative-path validation + explicit '..' part rejection, matching the approach used for web-app assets. Unit tests confirm traversal outside docs_dir is rejected (both literal and percent-encoded). Unknown pages and invalid paths return JSON 404, not file content. No credential handling, network calls, or code execution paths introduced.
evidence.tests: Strong test coverage. C++ unit test (test/cpp/test_docs_endpoint.cpp) verifies: only .md files indexed, id/path format, title from H1 with fallback, byte sizes, sorted index, absent directory, .md suffix acceptance, unknown id rejection, and path-traversal rejection (both literal .. and embedded). Python server-endpoint tests verify: index returns 200 JSON with required fields, quad-prefix support (/v0, /v1, /api/v0, /api/v1) with url-prefix echoing, every advertised page fetches as 200 text/markdown, unknown pages and percent-encoded traversal return 404, POST /docs is rejected, and unversioned /docs and /docs/ return JSON 404 instead of falling through to SPA. No evidence of test weakening.

maintainer_todos.text: Start a running Lemonade server, fetch GET /v1/docs and confirm the response is a JSON index listing at least api/README and api/lemonade with version, format, id, title, url, and bytes fields, and that the urls use the same prefix (/v1) that was used to request the index.
Fetch GET /v1/docs/api/lemonade from the running server and confirm the response is text/markdown starting with "# Lemonade API" and containing the documented endpoint table.

Confirm that GET /v0/docs, GET /api/v0/docs, and GET /api/v1/docs all return a 200 JSON index with urls matching the requesting prefix, and that GET /docs returns a JSON 404 with an error message pointing to /v1/docs.

Connect an MCP client to a running server, call the lemonade_docs tool with no arguments and confirm it returns a summary listing the bundled pages, then call lemonade_docs with page set to "api/lemonade" and confirm it returns the markdown content of that page.

subject: feat(server): serve bundled API docs at /docs (#3347)
summary: Adds a bundled API documentation system that serves reference pages at GET /v1/docs (JSON index) and GET /v1/docs/{page} (markdown), plus an MCP tool lemonade_docs, and returns JSON 404 for unversioned /docs instead of falling through to the SPA UI.
verdict_reason: The PR introduces new user-facing API endpoints and an MCP tool that should be manually verified before release, but CI tests all pass, review was substantive, and no risky post-approval commits were added.
